question: Who among the following eminent musicians is a famous tabla player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Zakir Hussain**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain** is a renowned tabla player known globally for his virtuosity and contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• He has collaborated with various artists across different genres, enhancing the popularity of tabla worldwide.
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain has received numerous awards, including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan, for his outstanding contributions to music.
 
• He is the son of legendary tabla player Ustad Alla Rakha, and has carried forward his father's legacy with great distinction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Moinuddin Khan** is known for his expertise in playing the sarangi.
 
• **Ustad Bade Gulam Ali Khan** was a legendary vocalist in Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Ustad Abdul Rashid Khan** was an eminent vocalist and composer in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain has also contributed to the fusion genre, collaborating with artists like John McLaughlin and Mickey Hart.
 
• He is actively involved in teaching and promoting Indian classical music through various institutions and workshops.
